families.krea-2-turbo: Best photographic realism: portraits, skin, natural light, candid photos. Poor at readable text. Usually needs an explicit LoRA to show nudity.
families.flux2-klein: Fastest. Fine for simple everyday pictures. Weaker at fine detail, hands and text. Usually needs an explicit LoRA to show nudity.

loraRoles.realism: Makes a picture look like a real camera photo. Not for illustrations, paintings, posters or anything stylised
loraRoles.explicit: Explicit adult nudity and sex. Only when the user asks for nudity or sex; never for violence, gore or clothed people
loraRoles.body: Changes breast size. Only when the user asks for a different breast size
